newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * French President Jacques Chirac arrives for a two-day visit to Romania on Friday.
* Romania and Hungary must cooperate for both countries' integration into NATO and the European Union, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said after a meeting with Hungarian politicians.

* The exchange rate of the leu currency will be stabilised in the near future, the governor of the Romania's central bank told journalists. Isarescu had presented the issues wich the country's economy must face.
* The Democrat Party (PD) supports the government's plan to scrap the communist-era law withdrawing the citizenship of former King Michael, a party spokesman told a news conference.
